items.name: New Drawing
items.desc: Creates a new, empty AutoSPRINK drawing.

items.name: Plot Sheet
items.desc: Allows the user to add a plot sheet, access the Plot Sheet Manager, and import or export a Plot Sheet.

items.name: New Plot Sheet
items.desc: Creates a new AutoSPRINK drawing using plotter parameters.

items.name: Open
items.desc: Accesses the Open dialog box for opening a file. Navigate to the desired directory, find the name of the desired file in the list, and either click Open or double-click on the file name in the list.

items.name: Close
items.desc: Ends work on the current drawing. This closes the drawing but keeps AutoSPRINK active. (A user can also do this by clicking the close box in the upper right-hand corner of the drawing window.) If the drawing has not been saved,...

items.name: Save
items.desc: Saves changes for the current drawing. Drawing files are saved in .cad format.

items.name: Save As
items.desc: Opens the Save As dialog box for saving changes to the current drawing. This option allows a user to save the drawing under a different file name or save it to a different location.

items.name: Save All
items.desc: Saves changes for all open drawings.

items.name: Save All and Exit
items.desc: Saves changes for all open drawings and then closes the program.

items.name: AutoSave
items.desc: Allows the user to set parameters for automatically saving an existing drawing to disk.

items.name: Options
items.desc: Choose an alternative source for default settings.

items.name: Language
items.desc: Allows the user to select from available languages to use.

items.name: Load Settings
items.desc: Allows the user to open a specific document settings file.

items.name: Save Settings As
items.desc: Allows the user to save document settings to disk.

items.name: Load Toolbar State
items.desc: Load saved positioning and changes to the toolbars.

items.name: Save Toolbar State
items.desc: Saves positioning and changes to the toolbars.

items.name: Import
items.desc: This submenu has options for importing a 3DS model (.3ds format) or an AutoCAD drawing (.dwg format) into AutoSPRINK. In either case, AutoSPRINK will reproduce the imported file in .cad format, translating elements, mimicking fonts and...

items.name: Export
items.desc: This submenu has options for exporting an AutoSPRINK drawing to an AutoCAD file, or for exporting drawing data into AutoSPRINK Fab, or for exporting pipe and sprinkler data in ASCII format.

items.name: Plotting
items.desc: This submenu has options for generating hard copies of a drawing according to the user's chosen page and printer settings. This includes a print preview mode that will show a drawing as it will actually appear, and that also allows a...

items.name: Printing
items.desc: This submenu has options for generating hydraulic, stock listing, or purchase order reports related to a current drawing, and also allows a user to set up report printer parameters.

items.name: Licensing
items.desc: This submenu allows access to licensing dialogs for both AutoSPRINK and the stock listing functions. Without valid license numbers and passwords, stock listing and many other features of AutoSPRINK will be disabled.

items.name: Source Control
items.desc: This submenu has options for checking in/out a document, getting the most updated document, adding a file and being able to change binding.

items.name: Recent Files
items.desc: A list of the most recent files opened in AutoSPRINK appears near the bottom of the File menu. Click on a file name to immediately open that file.

items.name: Exit
items.desc: Closes AutoSPRINK. (The program will prompt you to save any unsaved files before closing.)

items.name: Undo
items.desc: Restores the drawing to its state prior to the most recent action.

items.name: Redo
items.desc: Restores the most recently undone action.

items.name: Cut
items.desc: Removes the selected item(s) from the drawing onto the Clipboard, so that the selected item(s) can be pasted elsewhere.

items.name: Copy
items.desc: Duplicates the selected item(s) in the drawing and places the copy on the Clipboard to be pasted elsewhere.

items.name: Paste
items.desc: Inserts a previously cut or copied selection into the drawing.

items.name: Delete
items.desc: Erases a selection from the drawing.

items.name: Delete All
items.desc: Erases everything from the drawing field.

items.name: Lock View Element
items.desc: Lock view element will lock a view that you have placed in a sheet.

items.name: Copy Bitmap
items.desc: Takes a snapshot of the current drawing field; this snapshot can be inserted into the drawing as a Picture element.

items.name: Copy Element Bitmap
items.desc: Copies either a view or picture element at its native resolution in .bmp format to the Clipboard for use in other programs.

items.name: Paste Bitmap
items.desc: Takes the copied snapshot and places it as a picture element in the drawing field.

items.name: Undo List...
items.desc: Displays a list of all actions taken since the last save, allowing multiple actions to be undone quickly.

items.name: Redo List...
items.desc: Displays a list of all actions undone since the last undo action, allowing multiple actions to be redone quickly.

items.name: Find & Replace
items.desc: Searches selected text within the drawing for specified words or phrases and allows you to replace specified words or phrases with different text that you specify.

items.name: All
items.desc: Selects all elements in the drawing.

items.name: All Like Selected
items.desc: Selects all elements in the drawing of the same type as the element currently selected.

items.name: Every
items.desc: Lists element types that can be selected. Choosing a type selects all elements of that type in the drawing.

items.name: Last
items.desc: Reselects the items the user selected in the previous action.

items.name: All in Rectangle
items.desc: Equips the cursor with the rectangle tool; all items with all grips captured within the rectangle are added to the current selection.

items.name: Crossing Window
items.desc: Equips the cursor with the rectangle tool. All elements with one or more grips captured within the rectangle are added to the current selection.

items.name: Alt-Window
items.desc: Equips the cursor with the rectangle tool. All elements with one or more grips captured within the rectangle are added to the current selection; however, grips not captured within the rectangle remain anchored to their current positions.

items.name: Crossing Line
items.desc: Equips the cursor with the line tool. All elements with any part crossing the line are added to the current selection.

items.name: Rectangular Crossing
items.desc: Equips the cursor with the rectangle tool. All elements with any part crossing the four lines that form the rectangle are added to the current selection.

items.name: Invert Selection
items.desc: Selects all currently unselected elements; deselects all currently selected elements.

items.name: Deselect All
items.desc: Deselects any elements currently selected.

items.name: Maintain Connections
items.desc: Maintains connections between/among selected Walls or Beams, so that when a wall or beam is moved, connected walls or beams will stretch to that wall or beam's new position.

items.name: Toggle Ctrl Key
items.desc: Makes any subsequent commands be performed as if the CTRL key was pressed; while this option is active and the CTRL key is pressed, commands will be performed as if the CTRL key is not pressed.

items.name: Select with Filter
items.desc: Opens the Selection dialogue, listing potential selections to be added to or removed from the current selection.

items.name: Next Target
items.desc: If the cursor is placed so that multiple elements could be selected (e.g. pointed to multiple overlapping elements in top view), this shifts the selection status to the element in the set after the currently selected element.

items.name: Previous Target
items.desc: If the cursor is placed so that multiple elements could be selected (e.g. pointed to multiple overlapping elements in top view), this shifts the selection status to the element in the set before the currently selected element.

items.name: Cursor Type
items.desc: Choose between Rectangular, Elliptical, or Polyline selection cursor types.

items.name: All Like Selected in Rectangle
items.desc: Equips the cursor with the rectangle tool; all items with all grips captured within the rectangle, and are of the same type as the element currently selected, are added to the current selection.

items.name: All Like Selected on Same Layer
items.desc: Selects all elements in the drawing of the same type and on the same layer as the element currently selected.

items.name: All on Selected Layer(s)
items.desc: Selects all elements on the same layer as the element currently selected.

items.name: By ID
items.desc: Select an element by its unique ID number (found on the General tab in the element's Properties dialog).

items.name: Z-Lock
items.desc: Forces drawing to drag on the Z axis while in isometric view.

items.name: Elevation Lock
items.desc: Allow the user to draw pipes at a locked elevation.

items.name: Alter Benchmark Elevation/Rotation
items.desc: Allows the benchmark to be set at a specific location and rotation relative to its current location and rotation.

items.name: Auto Benchmark
items.desc: Makes the benchmark move from point to point as you draw elements.

items.name: Visible Benchmark
items.desc: Hides the benchmark from view.

items.name: Orthographic
items.desc: Snaps the element you are drawing or moving at 45° or 90° angles. (The [Shift] key toggles this mode.)

items.name: Protractor
items.desc: Displays a protractor that allows pipes to be easily snapped 90, 45, 22.5, 11.25, or 0 degrees.

items.name: Center Point
items.desc: Snaps the element you are drawing or moving to the center of another element.

items.name: End Points
items.desc: Snaps the element you are drawing or moving to any grip of another element. (Also sometimes referred to as Location snap.)

items.name: Perpendicular All
items.desc: Snaps the element you are drawing or moving at right angles to another element (relative to the benchmark) along the Z-axis.

items.name: Perpendicular
items.desc: Snaps the element you are drawing or moving at right angles to another element (relative to the benchmark).

items.name: Intersections All
items.desc: Snaps the element you are drawing or moving to the intersection of two or more other elements in three dimensions.

items.name: Intersections
items.desc: Snaps the element you are drawing or moving to the intersection of two or more other elements.

items.name: Near
items.desc: Snaps the element you are drawing or moving to anywhere along another element’s visible lines.

items.name: Tangent
items.desc: Draws the cursor to a location touching a single point along a curve.

items.name: Special Element
items.desc: Snaps the element you are drawing or moving to another element in a way unique to the individual elements involved.

items.name: Pipe to Sprinkler Snap Options
items.desc: Allows access to special options for snapping pipes to sprinklers in your drawing.

items.name: Snap into Symbols
items.desc: Snaps the element you are drawing or moving to items grouped in a symbol. Works in coordination with other snaps.

items.name: Sprinkler Ceiling Snap
items.desc: Snaps sprinklers to points on a ceiling grid. You must set a ceiling snap layer before using this command.

items.name: Enable Element Snaps
items.desc: Activates any snaps selected. This is also a quick way to turn off all snaps.

items.name: UCS - Auto Benchmark Rotation
items.desc: Automatically rotates the benchmark to the direction a pipe is placed in when snapped to an existing pipe in the drawing.

items.name: UCS - Auto Ortho Snaps
items.desc: Automatically rotates the direction of pipe when snapped to an existing pipe.

items.name: UCS - Ortho Input
items.desc: Allows users to enter a distance into the input toolbar and move the pipe that distance in the direction that ortho is locked into.

items.name: Rounding
items.desc: Forces mouse input to the nearest rounding increment.

items.name: Visible Grid
items.desc: Shows a grid in the drawing. This grid is used by AutoSPRINK for rounding.

items.name: Move Benchmark
items.desc: Equips the cursor to relocate the benchmark to a point you select

items.name: FDC
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a Fire Department Connection in the drawing.

items.name: Fitting
items.desc: This submenu has options for various fittings with which to equip the cursor.

items.name: Flow Device
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a flow device (i.e. a gauge, alarm, or switch/sensor) in the drawing.

items.name: Hanger
items.desc: Opens a dialog box for determining hanger properties, then equips the cursor to place a hanger.

items.name: Hose
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a hose in the drawing.

items.name: Hydrant
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a hydrant in the drawing.

items.name: Hydraulic Wormhole
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a hydraulic wormhole in the drawing.

items.name: Nozzle
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a nozzle in the drawing.

items.name: Pipe
items.desc: This submenu has options for placing pipes in the drawing.

items.name: Pipe Outlet
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place an outlet on a pipe in the drawing.

items.name: Pump
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a pump in the drawing.

items.name: Sprinklers
items.desc: This submenu has options for placing sprinklers in the drawing.

items.name: Sprinkler Legend
items.desc: Opens a dialog box to place and create a sprinkler legend table that users may use up to ten columns of specific choices selected.

items.name: Strainer
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a strainer in the drawing.

items.name: Supply
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a supply in the drawing.

items.name: Sway Brace
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a Sway Brace in the drawing.

items.name: Dimension
items.desc: This submenu has options for a variety of dimension indicators with which to equip the cursor.

items.name: Leader Line
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a leader line in the drawing.

items.name: Text Box
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place text in a specified area in the drawing.

items.name: Text Line
items.desc: Equips the cursor to insert text along a designated line in the drawing.

items.name: Arc
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place an arc in the drawing field.

items.name: Circle
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a circle or ellipse in the drawing field.

items.name: Crosshatch
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a crosshatched area in the drawing.

items.name: Light
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a light element in the drawing. This element can be adjusted to change the luminance of the drawing.

items.name: Line Segment
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a line segment in the drawing.

items.name: Point
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a point in the drawing.

items.name: Polyline
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a jointed line (i.e. a series of connected line segments) in the drawing.

items.name: Rectangle
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place and size a rectangle in the drawing.

items.name: Sketch
items.desc: Allows you to sketch freely in the drawing. The resulting element has properties of a polyline.

items.name: Solid
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a four-sided solid in the drawing.

items.name: Symbol
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a symbol in the drawing.

items.name: Beam
items.desc: This submenu has options for types of beams with which to equip the cursor.

items.name: Ceiling Grid
items.desc: Equips the cursor to set the boundary of a ceiling tile grid in the drawing.

items.name: Ceiling Grid Features
items.desc: This submenu has options for ceiling grid features with which to equip the cursor.

items.name: Column
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a column in the drawing.

items.name: Column Line
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a column line in the drawing.

items.name: Roof Plane
items.desc: Equips the cursor to establish a roof plane section in the drawing.

items.name: Wall
items.desc: This submenu has options for types of walls with which to equip the cursor.

items.name: Areas
items.desc: This submenu has options for types of boundary delineation tools for concealing, identifying and classifying various regions of the drawing.

items.name: View
items.desc: Equips the cursor to stretch an area within the drawing into which a snapshot of another saved drawing may be inserted.

items.name: Protractor
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a protractor in the drawing.

items.name: Ruler
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a ruler in the drawing.

items.name: Coverage Cell
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place an adjustable boundary into the drawing in order to provide the area enclosed with appropriately spaced and arranged sprinkler system components.

items.name: 3 Point Coverage Cell
items.desc: Equips the cursor to establish the length and width of an adjustable boundary in the drawing in order to provide the area enclosed with appropriately spaced and arranged sprinkler system components.

items.name: Part Tag
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a part tag in the drawing.

items.name: Cloud
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a cloud element in the drawing.

items.name: Cylinder
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a cylinder in the drawing.

items.name: Picture
items.desc: Allows a bitmap image from an external file to be inserted into the drawing.

items.name: XRef
items.desc: Opens a submenu for selection of the external file to reference for a set of externally referenced drawing data, also called an Xref, then equips the cursor to place the Xref data in the drawing.

items.name: Modeling
items.desc: This submenu has options for a variety of basic modeling objects with which to equip the cursor.

items.name: Board
items.desc: Two sub-menu options are available for placing the Board. The Board can be placed by its end locations or by its corner and edge locations. Equips the cursor to place a board in the drawing.

items.name: Openings
items.desc: This submenu has options for types of openings to create in a beam or wall element in the drawing.

items.name: Slab
items.desc: Two sub-menu options are available for placing the Slab. The Slab can be placed by its end locations or its corner and edge locations. Equips the cursor to place a concrete slab in the drawing.

items.name: Callout
items.desc: Equip the cursor to place a rectangle selection for an area that can be used to plot.

items.name: Link
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a connection to an external file into the drawing.

items.name: Section
items.desc: Equips the mouse cursor with a selection cursor that can be used to add a section to the drawing. Section views can be created using the Create Section View command in the Commands menu.

items.name: Pipe Sleeve
items.desc: Equips the cursor to place a sleeve on a pipe in the drawing.

items.name: Text Leader Line
items.desc: Equips the cursor to insert a leader line for text in the drawing.

items.name: Clipping Planes
items.desc: This submenu has options for types of clipping planes to place in the drawing.

items.name: Hide Layers
items.desc: Renders selected layers invisible by turning off the layers on which the selected elements reside. Use the Layer Pane to restore visibility.

items.name: Reparent Layers
items.desc: Creates a new parent layer for the selected element and its associated layers.

items.name: Group Existing Labels
items.desc: Consolidates selected labels or groups labels into a single unit. Only selected labels can be grouped.

items.name: Un-group Existing Labels
items.desc: Separates grouped labels back into individual labels. This command applies only to labels that were previously grouped.

items.name: Offset Move/Copy
items.desc: Moves or copies selected elements using numeric input.

items.name: Set Text Angle
items.desc: Specifies the angle at which text is displayed to improve drawing readability.

items.name: Bind XRef Symbols
items.desc: Binds selected symbols that reference external drawing files (also called XRefs) into the current drawing.

items.name: Reload XRef Symbols
items.desc: Reload selected XRefs from their source files.

items.name: Create Detail
items.desc: Groups selected drawing elements into a detail treated as a single unit with properties used for stocklisting and trimming.

items.name: Split Drawing Using Control Areas
items.desc: Splits drawing elements from the selected control areas.

items.name: Split Drawing Using Polyline Boundary
items.desc: Splits drawing elements at a closed polyline boundary.

items.name: Round
items.desc: Adjusts all insertion points of selected elements, fitting them to the nearest grid point according to the current rounding increment.

items.name: Cleanup Text
items.desc: Spreads out overlapping text to improve drawing readability.

items.name: Fillet Pipes
items.desc: Rounds intersecting pipes at a specified radius.

items.name: Flatten
items.desc: Sets the elevation (Z-axis) of all selected elements to zero.

items.name: Flatten Dimensioning
items.desc: Positions selected dimension lines and their associated elements to the benchmark's Z height.

items.name: Copy/Flatten Text
items.desc: Improves text appearance in isometric views by copying and flattening text elements. This command also allows assignment of a different layer for the copied and flattened text, if desired.

items.name: Align Labels with Parent Element
items.desc: Allows pipe, pipeline, and sprinkler labels to align and rotate along with the parent pipe as it is moved.

items.name: Assign Column Names
items.desc: Allows users to assign names to the columns in a drawing.

items.name: Assign Heights to Columns
items.desc: Allows users to specify the height of columns in a drawing.

items.name: Break
items.desc: Breaks selected elements at 2D intersections with the line-based, target element. This will break selected elements at a 3D intersection if the target is the benchmark.

items.name: Center Ceiling Grid Between Walls
items.desc: Changes the position of the center grip of the selected ceiling tile grid in order to keep all edge tiles on each side the same size.

items.name: Center Sprinklers on Ceiling Tiles
items.desc: Repositions sprinklers placed on a ceiling tile to the center of the tile.

items.name: Create Part Tags
items.desc: Creates part labels for all selected elements.

items.name: Convert Elements
items.desc: From this submenu, choose into what elements or details the selected elements should be converted.

items.name: Divide
items.desc: Will create point elements at even intervals along the perimeter of the selected element.

items.name: Reverse
items.desc: This submenu allows you to turn fittings, pipelines or pipeline segments in the opposite direction.

items.name: Slabs
items.desc: Cut slabs where they are intersected by lines.

items.name: Split Pipeline
items.desc: Divides a pipeline at the end of a segment marked by benchmark placement at the desired point of separation.

items.name: Verify Drawing Elements
items.desc: Checks all elements in a drawing to ensure that they are within a user-specified threshold for dimension, line width, and DB size.

items.name: Analyze Sprinkler Coverage Areas
items.desc: Evaluates the coverage area for the selected sprinkler(s) in a drawing.

items.name: Boards: Cut/Extract Cut Lines
items.desc: Cuts and drills boards that are selected, and has ability to extract cut lines as well.

items.name: Calculate Slab Dimensions
items.desc: Calculates the Total Mass and Total Volume for the Slab(s).

items.name: Calculate Wall Dimensions
items.desc: Calculates Total Length for a continuous, rectangle, or single wall in a drawing.

items.name: Create Callout View
items.desc: Place a view for an area that has been selecting using the Callout tool.

items.name: Create Section View
items.desc: Creates a view of an area that has been selected using the Section tool.

items.name: Create Sprinkler Legend from View
items.desc: Creates a sprinkler legend for a view that has been created.

items.name: Complex Symbols
items.desc: Create a complex symbol relationship between selected symbol and targeted part.

items.name: Deflector Position Checking
items.desc: Evaluates the deflector position of the highlighted sprinklers in relation to all visible roof planes in the drawing.

items.name: Delete Pipes & Close Gaps
items.desc: Removes a selected pipe segment, then extends the adjacent pipes and connects them.

items.name: Dimension Selected
items.desc: From this submenu, choose to add running dimensions to sprinklers, hangers, or pipes.

items.name: Draw Sprinkler Coverage
items.desc: Allows you to draw the sprinkler coverage area for the selected sprinkler.

items.name: Elevate Beams
items.desc: Elevates beams to roof planes or a specified distance.

items.name: Elevate to Pipes
items.desc: Moves selected elements to the nearest pipe on the Z-axis.

items.name: Format Dimension Text
items.desc: If you have changed units of measure in your drawing, converts selected measurement labels to the newly designated unit.

items.name: Offset
items.desc: Add a 45° or 90° offset at the midpoint of selected pipe.

items.name: Match Pipe Ends to Fittings
items.desc: Adjusts end preps on pipes to conform to attached fittings.

items.name: Merge Pipelines
items.desc: Joins selected pipelines to form a single unit. Only pipelines linked end to end can be merged.

items.name: Modeling
items.desc: This submenu allows access to various modeling functions available in AutoSPRINK via the Symmetrica CAD engine.

items.name: Resize Assembly
items.desc: Change the size of selected pipes and fittings.

items.name: Slope Pipes
items.desc: Slope pipes up or down by a selected increment.

items.name: Spell Check Text
items.desc: Spell-checks text within the drawing, and offers suggestions for spelling corrections.

items.name: Sway Bracing
items.desc: This submenu allows users to access sway bracing functions. Sway bracing is a line element that is used to attach pipes to ceiling planes.

items.name: Tag Leaks
items.desc: Alerts users when connections between pipes and fittings or outlets are leaking, and places an alert element next to the leak in the drawing.

items.name: Elevate Pipes
items.desc: Set elevation for selected pipes.

items.name: Set Sprinkler Coverage from Dimension
items.desc: Set coverage for sprinkler(s) based on the dimension of the sprinkler(s).

items.name: Couplings
items.desc: Searches the drawing and automatically places couplings based on user-defined settings to ensure accurate stock listing.

items.name: Fittings
items.desc: Validates connections between selected pipes and automatically inserts required fittings as needed.

items.name: Hangers
items.desc: Automatically places hangers on selected pipes based on user-defined settings.

items.name: Auto Branch Lines
items.desc: Draws branch lines to selected sprinkler heads based on user-defined settings.

items.name: Easy Drop
items.desc: Splits vertical pipes that are connected to sprinklers into user-defined segment lengths and inserts appropriate couplings automatically.

items.name: Remote Area Boundary
items.desc: Creates a remote area boundary for one or more selected sprinklers based on coverage area styles. If multiple sprinklers are selected, a single boundary is created representing the combined coverage.

items.name: Riser Nipples
items.desc: Automatically places riser nipples to connect branch lines to cross mains based on user-defined settings.

items.name: Route Pipe
items.desc: Intelligently routes pipes between selected points, automatically adjusting for drawing conditions such as slopes or obstacles.

items.name: Auto Size
items.desc: Adjusts selected pipes to match the current schedule settings.

items.name: Sprinkler Coverage
items.desc: Creates coverage boundaries for all selected sprinkler heads.

items.name: Arm Around
items.desc: Automatically resolves object conflicts by rerouting pipes around intersecting elements.

items.name: Bushings
items.desc: Automatically places bushings as needed for selected elements to ensure proper connections.

items.name: Automatic Roof Planes
items.desc: Generates a roof plane for a selection of columns or walls.

items.name: Elevate Elements to Roof Planes
items.desc: Raises selected items to the height of the roof plane.

items.name: Rotate Beams to Roof Planes
items.desc: Orients beams so that the top plane of the beam matches the slant of the roof plane.

items.name: Rotate Sprinklers to Roof Planes
items.desc: Allows selected sprinklers to rotate along with the roof plane's orientation.

items.name: Stretch Columns to Roof Plane
items.desc: Extends the length of selected columns until they meet the roof plane.

items.name: Stretch Hangers
items.desc: Extends selected hangers to an existing roof plane directly above.

items.name: Stretch Sway Braces
items.desc: Extends selected sway braces to an existing roof plane directly above.

items.name: Column Grid
items.desc: Lays out a structured area formed by intersecting column lines, with columns located at each intersection of the grid and labeling bubbles located at the end of each column line. The current location of the benchmark will determine the...

items.name: Grid System
items.desc: Lays out a grid system according to the details you supply. Dimensions, pipe schedule, orientation and source along with numerous other selectable specifications define the structure of the system.

items.name: Tree System
items.desc: Lays out a tree system according to the details you supply. Dimensions, pipe schedule, orientation and source along with numerous other selectable specifications define the structure of the system.

items.name: 3-Point System
items.desc: Lets you select a 3-point area to be covered before the system details are addressed and offers the choice of a tree or grid system to cover that area. The wizard then lays out a fire sprinkler schematic according to the details you supply.

items.name: In-Rack System
items.desc: Lays out an in-rack system according to the details you supply. Dimensions, orientation and source along with numerous other selectable specifications define the structure of the system.

items.name: Loop System
items.desc: Lays out a loop system according to the details you supply. Dimensions, pipe schedule, orientation and source along with numerous other selectable specifications define the structure of the system.

items.name: Multi-Point System
items.desc: Lets you select a multi-point area to be covered before the system details are addressed and offers the choice of a tree or grid system to cover that area. The wizard then lays out a fire sprinkler schematic according to the details you...

items.name: Standpipe
items.desc: Lays out a standpipe system according to the details you supply. The number of levels, rotation and demand along with numerous other selectable specifications define the structure of the system.

items.name: Advanced Drop Connect
items.desc: The newest of the Wizards, the Advanced Drop Connect offers an enhanced connection logic between pipes and sprinklers. It also offers greater flexibility to define these connections, and consolidates groups of sprinkler heads to ensure...

items.name: Place Hangers
items.desc: Lays out hanger placement.

items.name: Place Sprinklers in Ceiling Grid
items.desc: Allows the user to easily place sprinklers on a ceiling grid according to specified parameters.

items.name: Auto Peak
items.desc: Searches along branch lines within the selected remote area to find the greatest system demand.

items.name: Keep Hydraulically Most Demanding Area
items.desc: Evaluates each remote area selected, then determines which is the hydraulically most demanding. All others will be discarded.

items.name: Analysis Reports
items.desc: Displays graphically the hydraulic information for the currently selected remote area in the drawing.

items.name: Remote Area
items.desc: Allows you to define the hydraulically weakest region of the sprinkler system.

items.name: Remote Area Boundary
items.desc: Allows you to draw the boundary surrounding a remote area, segment by segment.

items.name: Manual Hydraulic Graph
items.desc: Allows users to manually create a hydraulic graph.

items.name: System Optimizer
items.desc: Allows you to modify the currently selected pipe to see what effect it will have on the system’s demand characteristics.

items.name: Update Riser Tags
items.desc: Updates information in selected riser tags.

items.name: Remote Area Box
items.desc: Allows you to draw a box around a remote area.

items.name: Remote Area Table
items.desc: Generates a Remote Area's hydraulic information, in graphical form, into the drawing.

items.name: Check Point Gauge
items.desc: Allows you to place gauges throughout a sprinkler design. Gauges provide pressure and flow statistics on the Remote Area Data tab of the Analysis Reports dialog.

items.name: Riser Tag
items.desc: Allows you to place a riser tag in your drawing.

items.name: Supply Table
items.desc: Allows you to place a supply table in your drawing.

items.name: Flow Calculator
items.desc: Allows you to derive flow, pressure and K-factor using the standard flow formula.

items.name: Hydrant Flow Calculator
items.desc: Allows you to determine discharge for smoothbore nozzles when given values for the constant, the diameter of the nozzle and the pressure on the pilot gauge.

items.name: Show Pipe Volumes
items.desc: Displays the volume of air and water in selected pipes.

items.name: Harmonize Pipes and Fittings
items.desc: Automatically harmonizes your pipes and fittings.

items.name: Manufacturer Harmonizing
items.desc: Automatically harmonizes your selections' manufacturers if possible.

items.name: Labels
items.desc: Lets user choose which items in the selection will be labeled.

items.name: Cleanup Intersections
items.desc: Breaks selected elements possessing similar properties into segments at their point(s) of intersection, except if they are collinear, in which case the elements are fused into a single line.

items.name: Match Pipe Ends to Fittings
items.desc: Adjusts end preps on pipes to conform to attached fittings.

items.name: Cleanup Text
items.desc: Spreads out overlapping text to improve readability of your drawing.

items.name: Flatten Dimensioning
items.desc: Positions selected dimension lines and their associated elements at the same Z height as the benchmark.

items.name: Delete All Alerts
items.desc: Deletes all Alerts regardless of status.

items.name: Interference Checking
items.desc: Searches for collisions between pipes and beams or pipes and other pipes.

items.name: Alert List Sets Target Element
items.desc: Designates Alert highlighted in the Alerts Pane as the target element.

items.name: Delete Closed Alerts
items.desc: Deletes all Alerts with a status of Closed.

items.name: Alert Report
items.desc: Displays a Report listing Alerts for the current drawing. Data includes ID, status, notes, the primary image, and images associated with additional notes.

items.name: Synchronize Alerts
items.desc: Saves alerts to the Alert Database or retrieves alerts from the database.

items.name: Load Resolution Proposals
items.desc: Loads alerts associated with elements that produced the resolution proposal.

items.name: Save Resolution Proposals
items.desc: Saves alerts associated with elements that produced the resolution proposal.

items.name: Resolution Manager
items.desc: The Alert Resolution Proposal Manager dialog aids in indicating any alert resolution process.

items.name: Alert Controls
items.desc: This dialog provides various Alert settings options.

items.name: Trades Configuration
items.desc: Allows users to create new trades, manages which trades are assigned to alerts and the priority level of each trade.

items.name: Assign Elements to Trade Layer
items.desc: Assign an element to a trade layer to be automatically assigned an alert during interference checking.

items.name: Assign Price Area
items.desc: Gathers information on selected system components, grouping them under a designation you specify for presentation in a text table or AutoPRICER Estimating Report.

items.name: Assign List Area
items.desc: Gathers information on selected system components, grouping them under a designation you specify for presentation in a Bill of Materials or Stock Listing Report.

items.name: Active List Area
items.desc: Indicates which list area is currently active, and also where new elements should be placed (in the active list area, or in the list area matching the appropriate default properties element).

items.name: Listing Manager
items.desc: Displays description, element count and date last listed for each list area in the drawing, along with options to generate a Bill of Materials or a Stock Listing Report.

items.name: Bill of Material (BOM)
items.desc: Compiles a wide variety of product information for each item implemented in the drawing, then equips the cursor to place the data into the drawing in chart form.

items.name: Price Area Text Table
items.desc: Compiles material cost, cost per sprinkler, and area per sprinkler in addition to the total cost for the components within a selected portion of a sprinkler system, then equips the cursor to place this data into the drawing in chart form.

items.name: Calculate Weight
items.desc: Opens the Weight Calculations dialog, which displays the Pipe Weight Dry and Pipe Weight Wet calculations within the chosen boundary based on a full or partial selection of a drawing.

items.name: Calculate Surface Area
items.desc: Opens the Calculate Surface Area dialog, which displays the total surface area of all selected pipes.

items.name: Add New Parts Book Item
items.desc: Opens a dialog listing parts book items and categories that can be created with a customized set of properties.

items.name: Edit Parts Book Item
items.desc: Alters properties of a created component in the Parts Database.

items.name: Remove Parts Book Item
items.desc: Deletes components from the Parts Database.

items.name: Sprinkler Definition Wizard
items.desc: Allows users to select the parameters for the sprinklers to be added to the database.

items.name: Pump Definition Wizard
items.desc: Can be used to create a custom pump.

items.name: View Parts List
items.desc: Opens a dialog presenting all system components stored in the Parts Database and their characteristics.

items.name: Database Utilities
items.desc: This submenu offers several parts database file maintenance options.

items.name: Add New / Edit Parts Book Manufacturer
items.desc: Allows you to include parts producers and brands not currently listed, or alter parts producers and brands already in the database.

items.name: Parts Book Quick Data Editors
items.desc: This submenu has options for editing specific aspects of parts book components, including item level data, part numbers, costs, stock item data, equivalent lengths, item visibility, job types, sprinkler identification number (SIN) data,...

items.name: Arrange Sortable Lists
items.desc: Allows the rearrangement of sort orders to multiple list types.

items.name: Add Detail as Trim Kit
items.desc: Allows users to create a Parts Book kit from detail created in drawings.

items.name: Synchronize Properties of Default and Selected Elements
items.desc: Assigns the properties value of a highlighted element in the drawing to that element’s database profile so that all further use of the element type possesses the synchronized properties value.

items.name: Synchronize Costs of Default and Selected Elements
items.desc: Assigns the cost value of a highlighted element in the drawing to that element’s database profile so that all further use of the element type possesses the synchronized cost value.

items.name: Update Unknown User Pipes
items.desc: Changes all unknown user pipes to known pipes.

items.name: Database Utilities
items.desc: This menu offers the parts database file maintenance options

items.name: Host Drawing Manager
items.desc: Organizes a set of .dwg or .cad files based on their reference relationships.

items.name: Drawing Compare - Multiple
items.desc: Allows users to compare drawings and generate a comparison result. After the comparison is created, the End Compare dialog opens, providing access to options for reviewing and managing the comparison.

items.name: Drawing Compare - Review
items.desc: Allows to review an existing drawing comparison. This option allows users to reopen the comparison file if it was previously closed, or reopens the End Compare dialog if the comparison is still active, allowing users to review and...

items.name: Reports - Print
items.desc: Opens the AutoPREP Report Logs dialog, where report logs for Host Drawing Manager Reports and Compare Reports can be viewed, printed, and deleted.

items.name: Drawing Cleanup
items.desc: Allows users to define a series of cleanup commands to run on drawings prior to import. These command sequences can be reused or recorded into a wizard to help standardize and simplify drawing preparation workflows.

items.name: Drawing
items.desc: Allows you to set a Drawing Description, adjust the View, Rounding, Background and Lighting. In addition, Job, Customer and Contractor can be specified and Miscellaneous re-scale and display options are available. Finally, Project...

items.name: Fabrication Standards
items.desc: Allows you to specify details regarding how AutoSPRINK places fittings and outlets on pipes, as well as to what degree the entries in the Parts Book are used.

items.name: Format
items.desc: Defines the way AutoSPRINK displays values in real world lengths as determined by the Drawing and View settings and the way actual paper distances are scaled to your drawing. Note that these settings do not affect how AutoSPRINK stores...

items.name: Hydraulic Calculations
items.desc: Defines characteristics for Calculation Method, Sprinkler Pressure, Hydraulic Loss at Fittings and Node Tag placement.

items.name: Parts Profile
items.desc: Sets what types of parts will be used when certain elements are placed in the drawing.

items.name: Render
items.desc: Specifies how your drawing will be rendered.

items.name: Use Smart Pipe
items.desc: This option toggles the use of the smart pipe system.

items.name: Minimize Pipe Label Spacing
items.desc: This option chooses logical label placement so labels are easily legible.

items.name: Allow Manual Takeout
items.desc: Enables the Cut Length section on the Pipe Properties dialog. It allows users to choose between Get takeout from connected fittings and Deduct a manual takeout are the two pipe cut length options.

items.name: Get Defaults from Selection
items.desc: Makes characteristics of a selected element the default properties for other elements of that type.

items.name: Properties
items.desc: Displays the properties page for the selected element.

items.name: Display Data Sheets on Property Pages
items.desc: Displays manufacturer's part-specific data sheets on property pages when turned on.

items.name: Ignore Lines During Cleanup Intersections
items.desc: Ignores all line elements in a drawing when the Cleanup Intersections command is executed.

items.name: Allow Views to XRef
items.desc: Allows users to enter a path on all View property pages.

items.name: Save Settings
items.desc: Saves drawing parameters to the user's personal folder.

items.name: Command Dialogs
items.desc: Allows users to set a command so an option dialog will display each time the command is executed.

items.name: Sprinkler Dimensions
items.desc: Allows users to specify when to show the dimensions surrounding line based elements when selected.

items.name: Get Defaults from Target
items.desc: Equips the cursor to draw an element with identical settings to that of another that happens to be situated among a broad selection.

items.name: Set Properties from Defaults
items.desc: Retrieves default properties of selected elements.

items.name: Common Properties
items.desc: Allows similar elements' properties to be defined. If dissimilar elements are highlighted in the drawing, an apples and oranges dialog appears that reads, "Properties for elements of different types are being shown." Only base property...

items.name: Filtered Properties
items.desc: Allows the filtering and definition of multiple elements' properties according to user's selection. Each group properties' definition can be given a unique name.

items.name: Part Selection Properties
items.desc: Easily adjust size, part number, cost, and quantity of selected elements. Each column header is sortable. Elements' default properties can be accessed and edited from this dialog.

items.name: Speech Recognition
items.desc: Turns on the speech recognition function, allowing voice commands to be used.

items.name: Customize Speech Recognition
items.desc: Allows custom speech recognition profiles to be created.

items.name: Automatically Capitalize Text
items.desc: Automatically capitalizes all new text when turned on.

items.name: Show Complex Symbols
items.desc: This option toggles the display of complex symbols.

items.name: Camera
items.desc: This submenu and its four submenus have many options for camera movement.

items.name: Rendering
items.desc: This submenu has options for drawing display and rendering.

items.name: Walkthrough
items.desc: This submenu has options for creating a walkthrough (a series of different views) of your drawing. It is known as Save/Restore View in some levels.

items.name: Enlarge Outlet Points on Fittings
items.desc: Increases the size of connection point indicators (which show the actual point to which a pipe penetrates a fitting).

items.name: Hide Pipe Labels
items.desc: Conceals pipe label text.

items.name: Register Bitmap Background
items.desc: Defines origin, dimensions and scale for an image used as a background.

items.name: Show Leaks
items.desc: Reveals areas of a sprinkler system where pipe or fitting connections are compromised.

items.name: Show Page Breaks
items.desc: Displays the arrangement of the drawing as it will appear on paper by indicating the borders of each page with dashed lines.

items.name: Show Pipe Insulation
items.desc: Toggles the display of Pipe Insulation in the current drawing. Unchecking can increase performance in drawings that include a great deal of insulation.

items.name: Calculator
items.desc: Opens the Calculator dialog. This allows you to perform complex calculations and insert the results directly into the Input Box.

items.name: Status Bar
items.desc: Displays the status bar at the bottom of the screen, which shows useful information about activities in progress.

items.name: Panes
items.desc: This submenu controls which panes are visible in your drawing.

items.name: Tool Bars
items.desc: This submenu offers a list of toolbars that can be displayed in AutoSPRINK.

items.name: Show Start Page
items.desc: Opens the Start Page.

items.name: Text Box Clipping Indicator
items.desc: Toggles display of a red underline at the bottom of a Text Box containing text that is hidden from view.

items.name: Refresh
items.desc: Redraws the entire screen display.

items.name: Refresh Elements
items.desc: Redraws selected elements only.

items.name: Color Pipes By
items.desc: Presents options for the pipe coloring scheme.

items.name: Highlight Make-on Connectors
items.desc: Highlights factory-attached end preps for fittings.

items.name: Show Sprinkler Dimensions
items.desc: Toggles the display of selected sprinkler proximity from target layer elements.

items.name: Abbreviate Views and Pictures
items.desc: Creates abbreviated views and pictures to speed performance.

items.name: Control Area Navigator
items.desc: Opens the Control Area Navigator tool for use in toggling between established Control Areas within the drawing.

items.name: Cascade
items.desc: Displays all open windows in a stack, in order from the most recently opened window (on top of the stack) to the first window opened (on the bottom). Only the most recently opened window is completely visible.

items.name: Tile
items.desc: Displays all open windows next to each other by dividing the viewing field into equal portions.

items.name: Arrange Icons
items.desc: Arranges icons for minimized drawing windows in a row at the bottom of the AutoSPRINK drawing pane.

items.name: Clean House
items.desc: Opens a dialog offering options to free up system resources if you are having performance problems while running AutoSPRINK.

items.name: Device Capabilities
items.desc: Displays information regarding your current display and printer drivers.

items.name: Open Drawings
items.desc: All drawings currently open in AutoSPRINK are listed at the bottom of this menu. A check mark appears next to the currently active drawing. Select any drawing on this list to make that drawing the active drawing.

items.name: Support Library
items.desc: Opens the AutoSPRINK help page with the table of contents displayed. Select topics in the Home menu to navigate the AutoSPRINK help page.

items.name: What's New
items.desc: Opens the What's New page on the AutoSPRINK website.

items.name: Tutorial Videos
items.desc: Opens the Training Videos on the AutoSPRINK website. Here you can find training courses, such as AutoSPRINK Pre-Training, Design Topic Webinars, and Tutorials.

items.name: Support
items.desc: Opens the Product Support page on the AutoSPRINK website. This page contains Support Videos and Contact Information for technical support.

items.name: AutoSPRINK Assistant
items.desc: Toggles on the appearance of the AutoSPRINK Assistant while using the program. AutoSPRINK Assistant informs users of the newest updates to specific functions, as well as how to use them.

items.name: Getting Started Guide
items.desc: Opens the Getting Started table of contents on the AutoSPRINK website.

items.name: About AutoSPRINK
items.desc: Displays version information and credits for AutoSPRINK.
